product.title: Key West Sunset Cruise: Dinner, Live Music & Drinks Included

description.text: Watch Key West's sunset — a main island attraction — on an evening dinner cruise. Feast on a tropical-themed buffet dinner and sip provided cocktails, beer, wine, and soft drinks as you take in views of the sea, the waterfront, and the sky's warm glow. Live music provides a festive atmosphere, and a cash bar is also available for premium drinks.Key West sunset dinner cruise Enjoy a tropical-themed buffet with several dishes Sip on provided margaritas, rum runners, wine, or beer Watch the sunset from the water — the best vantage point Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
